def analyze(phrase):
    """Return (ranks of recognized adjectives, well_formed flag)."""
    ranks, ok, noun_started = [], True, False
    for tok in phrase.split():
        if tok in RANK:
            if noun_started:
                ok = False  # adjective after the noun has started
            ranks.append(RANK[tok])
        else:
            noun_started = True
    return ranks, ok

def is_ordered(phrase):

    return ok and all(a <= b for a, b in zip(ranks, ranks[1:]))
